ModMetaData.name: Test Harness — Third-Mod Conditional Probe
ModMetaData.author: Joof
ModMetaData.description: The "third mod" for the CASE 9 live fixture (docs/patch-operations-coverage.md's open PatchOperationConditional nuance). Supplies exactly one def, TC_ThirdModProbe, and nothing else. It is neither the mod that owns the conditional (TestMod_Static) nor the mod whose content the conditional's branch mutates (TestMod_Defs) — it exists solely so its xpath-existence test has something to test. Present in Run A's modlist, REMOVED before Run B (a pure mod-list change, same shape as TestMod_Gate for P4), so TC_ThirdModProbe disappears entirely between runs while both TestMod_Static and TestMod_Defs are unchanged. No game content — dev/QA use only.
